section.title: Popular Direct Mail Formats for Local Businesses
section.description: We custom print and process a range of direct mail formats for businesses that want stronger local reach, better response rates, and more consistent brand visibility. Choose the right size, paper stock, and finishing options for your offer, audience, and service area.
section.note: Core fields (title, description, sizes/options/details/features) are sourced directly from the live page. Supplemental fields below are rewritten to be more SEO- and GEO-friendly for local business marketing, direct mail campaigns, and service-area visibility. Verify final mailing specs, pricing, and turnaround with FBS Signs before publishing.

formats.title: Postcards
formats.description: Postcards are one of the most effective direct mail formats for local promotions because they put your offer directly in the recipient's hand without requiring an envelope. They work well for product announcements, coupon campaigns, retail openings, seasonal offers, and neighborhood outreach. For businesses targeting nearby customers in cities like Chicago, Belvidere, Des Plaines, Westmont, or Montgomery, postcards deliver strong visibility at a low cost per piece and are easy to pair with EDDM or a targeted mailing list.

faqs.question: Do postcards work well for local business marketing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Postcards are a proven direct mail format for local business marketing because they deliver a clear message fast and are easy to target by neighborhood, route, or customer list.

faqs.question: Do I need a mailing list to send postcards?
faqs.answer: No. EDDM allows you to reach every address on selected USPS routes, which is a strong option for local promotions without purchasing a mailing list.

faqs.question: Which postcard size is best for response rate and visibility?
faqs.answer: 6" x 9" is often the strongest balance of mailbox visibility, print cost, and EDDM eligibility for many local campaigns.

faqs.question: What is the minimum order for postcard printing?
faqs.answer: Runs start at 500 pieces, which keeps the per-piece cost efficient while supporting larger neighborhood or citywide campaigns.

faqs.question: Can you help design the postcard for my business?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can provide print-ready artwork, or the design team can create a postcard layout tailored to your brand, offer, and service area.

faqs.question: How fast can postcards be turned around?
faqs.answer: Standard turnaround is 3-5 business days after proof approval, depending on quantity, finishing, and mail class.

formats.title: Letter Mailers
formats.description: Letter mailers are ideal for professional communication that needs to feel personal, secure, and official. They are a strong choice for business letters, account notices, newsletters, service reminders, solicitations, and renewal campaigns. Because the envelope format creates more privacy and trust, this option is especially useful for financial, nonprofit, utility, and membership communications that rely on clarity and personalization.
formats.detailsValue: Single window, Double window, reply envelope
formats.printSides: Full color or black & white, single or double-sided

faqs.question: Can every letter be personalized for each recipient?
faqs.answer: Yes. Variable data printing lets you customize names, account numbers, balances, notices, and offers so each mailer feels individually prepared.

faqs.question: Do you handle folding, stuffing, and sealing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Folding, insertion, and sealing are part of the production workflow so the mailers are ready for the post office after approval.

faqs.question: Can I include a reply envelope for payments or forms?
faqs.answer: Yes. Reply envelopes are a useful option for statements, donations, membership renewals, and returned documents.

faqs.question: What is the difference between single window and double window envelopes?
faqs.answer: Single window displays the recipient address, while double window can also show return information or account details printed on the letter itself.

faqs.question: Are letter mailers a good fit for service businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Service businesses use letter mailers for renewals, reminders, statements, and offers where trust and formal presentation matter.

faqs.question: How long does production usually take?
faqs.answer: Standard turnaround is 4-6 business days from final proof approval, depending on personalization, quantity, and finishing.

formats.title: Catalogs & Booklets
formats.description: Catalogs and booklets give you the space to present products, services, and brand stories in a format customers can review at their own pace. They are especially effective for seasonal collections, product lineups, lookbooks, and detailed service guides where one page is not enough. For businesses that want a more premium printed piece, this format supports multi-page storytelling while keeping the presentation organized and easy to follow.
formats.detailsValue: Coated or uncoated stock, up to 64 pages

faqs.question: Should I choose saddle-stitch or perfect binding?
faqs.answer: Saddle-stitch works well for thinner booklets, while perfect binding is better for thicker catalogs that need a more polished spine and premium look.

faqs.question: What is the maximum page count for this format?
faqs.answer: The standard maximum is 64 pages, but custom solutions may be available depending on the project and mailing method.

faqs.question: Can I order a smaller test run first?
faqs.answer: Yes. Short runs starting at 250 copies are a practical way to review layout, paper, and binding before a full production run.

faqs.question: Which paper stock is best for a premium catalog?
faqs.answer: A 100lb gloss cover paired with 80lb gloss text inside gives a strong, upscale presentation with good durability.

faqs.question: Are catalogs accepted by USPS?
faqs.answer: Yes. Catalogs and booklets can mail as USPS Marketing Mail Flats or Bound Printed Matter, depending on size, weight, and structure.

faqs.question: How long does catalog production take?
faqs.answer: Plan on 7-10 business days after proof approval for printing, binding, trimming, and quality review.

formats.title: Folded Self-Mailers
formats.description: Folded self-mailers are a smart choice when you want more space than a postcard but do not want to use an envelope. Bi-fold, tri-fold, and gate-fold layouts give you room for a headline, supporting details, images, and a strong call to action in one compact mail piece. This format is useful for promotional campaigns, service announcements, coupons, and multi-step offers that need a clean, self-contained presentation.

faqs.question: Do folded self-mailers need an envelope?
faqs.answer: No. Wafer seals hold the mailer closed, so it can mail without an envelope while still staying secure during delivery.

faqs.question: Can I include a detachable coupon or reply panel?
faqs.answer: Yes. Perforated panels can be used for coupons, forms, or reply pieces while keeping the main mailer intact.

faqs.question: Which fold type should I choose?
faqs.answer: Bi-folds work for simple two-panel messages, tri-folds suit brochure-style layouts, and gate-folds offer the most space for larger promotions.

faqs.question: Will the seals hold up through USPS sorting?
faqs.answer: Yes. Proper wafer tabbing is designed to meet mailing standards and stay secure through automated sorting.

faqs.question: How many usable panels does a gate-fold provide?
faqs.answer: A gate-fold typically provides up to six usable panels, making it a strong choice for product storytelling or multi-offer campaigns.

faqs.question: How long does production take?
faqs.answer: Production usually takes 5-7 business days after proof approval because folding and sealing add extra finishing time.
